note: USACE park at the east end of Harlan County Lake near Republican City. Two loops (HCOV and HCOV N); the south row of the main loop sits on the open lakeshore above the riprap. Paved main road, gravel loops. Playground, volleyball court, boat ramp and fish-cleaning station; two marinas on the east end. Attendant on duty May-September; all campers check in on arrival. --Claude
summary: Recreation.gov confirms the USACE campground, phone 308-799-2105, showers, 50 A electric with water at 7 sites, rates $18 (non-electric) to $34 in the May-September peak, and a first-come shoulder season in April and October-November at $20 walk-in electric; fees, sites, booking and season written (the derived 09-30 close is contradicted by the Oct-Nov FCFS season and cleared). Lakefront confirmed on the per-site plot: the main loop's south row (sites 077-091, 096-103) is on open grass above the riprap with the loop road behind it. Pin ~290 m from the site centroid.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront CONFIRMED: rec.gov per-site coordinates plotted on NAIP (lake at normal pool) put sites 077, 079, 081, 083, 086, 088, 090, 091, 096, 098, 101 and 102 on open mown grass within ~10-30 m of the riprap shoreline, with the loop road on their north (inland) side and no driveway, day-use area or road between pad and water. Esri's current frame shows a drawdown with ~150-200 m of exposed lakebed below the riprap, so at low water the shore is a mudflat. The northern HCOV N loop (001-053, 105-139) is inland.

PIN (optional, ~290 m): stored 40.0840,-99.2250 sits in the trees between the two loops east of the inner circle. The 129-site centroid is 40.08319,-99.22817 (the HCOV N loop spreads it west). The lakeshore row centres near 40.0820,-99.2235. Suggest 40.0832,-99.2282, or leave.

SEASON: cleared the derived 'closes 09-30' (from the availability calendar, which only shows reservable nights). The rate table keeps a first-come season April 1-30 and October 1 - November 30. Nothing states December-March; left unknown.
SITES: the description says 150 campsites; the catalog has 129 (plus 4 management). Stored count 150 left.
